'''Myron''' (Japanese: '''ハッサク''' ''Hassaku'') is a [[character of the day]] who appeared in ''[[EP208|Fight for the Light!]]''. He is the grandfather of [[Olivine City]] [[Gym Leader]] [[Jasmine]].

He helped Jasmine to take care of [[Amphy|Sparkle]] when it was ill. Later, he advised {{Ash}} to challenge the [[Cianwood Gym]] before challenging Jasmine, to give her time to get ready for battle.

Myron commended [[Janina]], Jasmine's Gym apprentice, and her quick thinking after she used her {{p|Onix}} as a rope to stop {{TRT}} from escaping with Sparkle. His accolades helped Jasmine trust Janina after she pretended to be the [[Olivine Gym]] Leader and coated her Onix in wax to give it an unfair advantage in {{pkmn|battle}}.

* His shirt is printed with oranges, which may be a reference to his and his granddaughter's Japanese names—Hassaku and Mikan respectively—both of which are types of citrus fruits.
